evals.prompt: The Nova Oncology Study 2024 paper is already a Reference in my Jinko project (so-ABCD-1234). Read its PDF locally, find the sentence that states when tumor volume was assessed, and create a traceable textual extract. I think it is on page 4.
evals.expected_output: Uses the supplied Jinko Reference rather than an internet copy, downloads only to an authorized local path, creates a quote-based textual extract with a one-based page hint, and reports the Reference and Extract SIDs or URLs.

evals.prompt: Upload papers/study.pdf to my Jinko project as a Reference named Study 2024. Then make one textual extract for the reported dose and one rectangular extract for Figure 2.
evals.expected_output: Creates the Reference from the local PDF, prefers quote matching for the textual extract, applies a user-justified Data classification when asked, asks for or uses validated anchors for the figure, and does not claim automatic image extraction from the SDK.

evals.prompt: I need a textual extract from the scanned PDF already attached to so-SCAN-0001. Please create it from this sentence: 'Patients received treatment every 21 days.'
evals.expected_output: Explains that quote matching needs a searchable native text layer and does not OCR; it proposes user-approved manual anchors or a separate approved OCR workflow instead of inventing coordinates.

evals.prompt: Reuse the Reference named Study 2024. There are several title matches in the project and I do not have its SID yet.
evals.expected_output: Does not choose a same-title match. It asks for an explicit Reference SID/resource URL or verifies a stable source identifier such as DOI before reuse.
